definitions.explanation: The act of taking medicine orally as directed. A formal term commonly used in medical and pharmaceutical contexts.

examples.japanese: {食後|しょくご}に{服用|ふくよう}してください。
この{薬|くすり}は{一日|いちにち}{三回|さんかい}{服用|ふくよう}する。
examples.english: This medicine is taken three times a day.

examples.japanese: {妊娠中|にんしんちゅう}の{方|かた}は、{服用|ふくよう}する{前|まえ}に{必|かなら}ず{医師|いし}に{相談|そうだん}してください。
examples.english: If you are pregnant, please be sure to consult a doctor before taking this medication.

notes:
USAGE:
{服用|ふくよう} is a formal, medical term for taking oral medication. Used with する. More formal than {薬|くすり}を{飲|の}む.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薬|くすり}を{服用|ふくよう}する (to take medicine)
- {食前|しょくぜん}に{服用|ふくよう}する (to take before meals)
- {食後|しょくご}に{服用|ふくよう}する (to take after meals)
- {服用量|ふくようりょう} (dosage)
- {服用|ふくよう}{方法|ほうほう} (how to take medicine)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {服用|ふくよう}: taking medicine orally (formal, medical)
- {飲|の}む: to drink; to take medicine (everyday)
- {投与|とうよ}: administering medication (used by medical professionals)
- {内服|ないふく}: oral administration (medical, technical)
